decision: **The reviewer merges a job on green CI.** A review with the verdict `merge` ends with `gh pr merge job/J<n> --auto --squash`: GitHub merges only when every required check (`gates`, `proxy`, `harness-windows`, `policy`) passes on the pushed commit, and no agent waits or polls. Other verdicts are never merged; `brief/`, `plan/` and `meta/` branches still wait for Liam. Replaces "a merge Liam approves" for job branches (D21 unchanged otherwise). `docs/REVIEW.md` "Output".
